d: High-strength, lightweight aluminum. It ships inside a standard 20-foot ISO container and suits helicopter, sealift, fixed-wing and vehicle transport — the TRECC-P fits a single 463L pallet.
Forklift pockets for loading and unloading. Optional removable wheel sets let an ATV tow it the last stretch.
It extends in height from five to eight feet. Furnishings ship inside the centre core, protected in transit.
It expands to three times its shipping footprint — set up in a few minutes by one or two people.
Weather-proof personnel doors on the expandable sides, interchangeable floor panels for workshops and offices — and it interconnects with other shelters into a larger facility.
